sqlFileAndLockSafetyRevision.scope: Parameterized values and server-owned dynamic SQL mapping; business files must not expose host filesystem management; content validation/quarantine/nonexecution; non-default locking reads with justified invariant and bounded transaction.
sqlFileAndLockSafetyRevision.screenshotAssessment: Bound MyBatis values and explicit locking read visible; application path and transaction caller not located, no live blocking/deadlock claim.
sqlFileAndLockSafetyRevision.validation: Five structures passed; SEC-017..019 examples and matrix IDs checked; package zero errors with five pending bindings and four new scheduled-rule source files missing in old commits. Current local links checked. Screenshot-only pattern assessment, no target repository inspection or runtime blocking/deadlock/exploit/antivirus test.

lockingGuidanceAudit.scope: Audited normative triggers, template rows, main skill entry, CRUD/database routing, completion gates, generator scripts, runnable positive examples, and local installed versions.
lockingGuidanceAudit.findings: No rule or generator directly mandates SQL FOR UPDATE; rules overgeneralize consistency requirements, one lock rule lacked conditional applicability, required template emphasized locks, detailed positive report recipe used explicit locking read, and entrypoint warning was only on database branch.
lockingGuidanceAudit.corrections: Existing sufficient protection/no new mechanism explicitly valid; ordinary reads nonlocking; lock rule conditional; template asks actual consistency not lock fields; direct entrypoint prevents checklist-driven locking; default report recipe uses closed immutable-window compute plus scoped conditional short commit instead of lockWindow/FOR UPDATE.
lockingGuidanceAudit.evidenceBoundary: Input files and old wording recorded; other team use/session not available, deterministic universal behavior or screenshot causality not proven. Installed skills untouched and still stale.
lockingGuidanceAudit.validation: Five skill structures passed; package zero errors with 5 pending authority bindings and 4 newly added scheduling sources absent from old commit. Reviewed295 Java/SQL/XML fenced examples across backend-development/review/design: no executable explicit locking-read or lockWindow recipe remains. This is an inventory, not a mandatory ban or semantic/behavior pass. Installed 3 skill entries unchanged; source corrections not distributed.

externalDataPolicyRevision.scope: No third-party website crawling; official/paid authorized acquisition only. Conditional routing, positive/negative examples, no external probing or SDK-internal review.
externalDataPolicyRevision.validation: 10 target skill structures and version checks passed; all SEC-020 full views/excerpts match authority.
